posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Talk about being disappointed. About two years ago I found an old SP 165 laser and power supply very reasonably priced and bought it. I worked on it a little and got it working. It works great. To my excitement when I got there it had an oven controlled etalon, I use an air spaced one now. I have been wanting to try the oven controlled one for quite some time. About a year ago I found the controller for the oven etalon. Well last night I took out the air spaced, changed the mounts, put in the oven controlled and worked for quite a while trying to get it tuned. It never dropped output power no matter how I moved, tweaked or heated it. So I took it out and looked through it at a light. I could not see any dust, reflection or nothing at all inside of it. I carefully too a cotton swab to and knew what I was hoping was not true.

There was not optic in it. Ahhhh, hahahahaha...... I could only break down and laugh. It never dawned on me to check and see if it has an optic on it or not..... 

Needless to say, I put back together the air spaced etalon and put it back in my laser.

If anyone has a homeless optic for a heat controlled etalon, I have a good home for it..... Hehehe...
